note: Triennial election of the county council on the post-1923 county electoral divisions; nominations closed 30 April 1924, polled 29 May 1924. No candidates were nominated for the Crossmaglen, Forkhill and Killeavy divisions (Frontier Sentinel, 10 May 1924, p. 5). Francis Short (Independent Nationalist) and Patrick Hughes (Hibernian) withdrew their nominations. The Lurgan Mail calls the division "Armagh Urban".
